title: Stocks tumble, Dow confirms correction, as Middle East war weighs

title: Anthropic eyes an October IPO, which could raise over $60B
title_zh: Anthropic 计划 10 月份进行 IPO，筹集资金超过 $60B
summary: Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley joins Josh Lipton to break down reports that Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) could go public as soon as October, as it looks to get ahead of OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) in the intensifying AI race.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经科技编辑丹·豪利 (Dan Howley) 与乔什·利普顿 (Josh Lipton) 一起详细分析了有关 Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) 最早可能在 10 月份上市的报道，因为它希望在日益激烈的人工智能竞赛中领先于 OpenAI (OPAI.PVT)。

title: Why you should 'never count out' Google
title_zh: 为什么你不应该“排除”谷歌
summary: On this segment of Market Madness, GraniteShares founder and CEO Will Rhind shares his stock picks for each matchup: Palantir (PLTR) vs. Robinhood (HOOD), Eli Lilly (LLY) vs. Walmart (WMT), Google (GOOG, GOOGL) vs. AMD (AMD), and Tesla (TSLA) vs. Bank of America (BAC).

title: 'Magnificent 7' stocks wipe more than $850 billion in value as stock market sell-off hits AI winners hard
title_zh: 随着股市抛售严重打击人工智能赢家，“Magnificent 7”股票市值蒸发超过 8500 亿美元
summary: "Magnificent Seven" stocks got hit this week as inflation fears rose and headwinds surfaced for the sector.
summary_zh: 由于通胀担忧加剧以及该行业面临的阻力浮出水面，“七大”股票本周受到打击。

title: Dow sheds nearly 800 points, stocks sink as volatility spikes higher
title_zh: 道指下跌近 800 点，股市因波动性加剧而下跌
summary: US stocks (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) are selling off in Friday's session, marking another week of losses for all three of the major indexes.
summary_zh: 美国股市（^DJI、^IXIC、^GSPC）在周五交易中遭到抛售，标志着三大股指又连续一周下跌。

title: Stock market today: S&P 500 clinches longest losing streak since 2022 as oil surges, 'Magnificent 7' stocks shed $300 billion
title_zh: 今日股市：随着油价飙升，标普 500 指数创下 2022 年以来最长连跌，“Magnificent 7”股票缩水 3000 亿美元
summary: The market sell-off continued on Friday even as Trump has postponed attacks against Iran's energy infrastructure.
summary_zh: 尽管特朗普推迟了对伊朗能源基础设施的攻击，但周五市场抛售仍在继续。

title: Apple hires ex-Google executive to head AI marketing amid push to improve Siri
title_zh: 苹果聘请前谷歌高管负责人工智能营销，推动改进 Siri
summary: SAN FRANCISCO, March 27 (Reuters) - Apple on Friday said it has hired Lilian Rincon, who previously spent nearly a decade at Google overseeing its shopping and assistant products, as the vice
summary_zh: 路透旧金山 3 月 27 日 - 苹果周五表示，已聘请 Lilian Rincon 担任副总裁，她曾在谷歌工作了近十年，负责监督其购物和助理产品。

title: Anthropic eyes IPO, Microsoft stock set for worst quarter since 2008
title_zh: Anthropic着眼于IPO，微软股价创下2008年以来最差季度表现
summary: Yahoo Finance Senior Producer John Hyland tracks Friday's top moving stocks and biggest market stories.Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) is reportedly considering going public as soon as October, according to the Information.Microsoft (MSFT) stock is on track for its worst quarter since 2008.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经高级制作人 John Hyland 追踪周五走势最强劲的股票和最大的市场故事。 据 Information 报道，Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) 正在考虑最早在 10 月份上市。 微软 (MSFT) 股票有望迎来 2008 年以来最糟糕的季度表现。

title: Meta stock falls on court ruling, but it still has 'one chance'
title_zh: Meta 股票因法院裁决而下跌，但仍有“一次机会”
summary: Meta (META) and YouTube (GOOG, GOOGL) were just found liable for damages in a landmark social media addiction lawsuit.
summary_zh: Meta (META) 和 YouTube (GOOG、GOOGL) 刚刚在一场具有里程碑意义的社交媒体成瘾诉讼中被判承担损害赔偿责任。
